description: This file defines the SearchIndexingInterface interface for Drupal's search module, specifying methods for updating, clearing, reindexing, and reporting index status.

classes.name: SearchIndexingInterface
classes.description: Defines an interface for search plugins that use an index, including methods for updating, clearing, reindexing, and checking index status.

methods.name: updateIndex
methods.description: Updates the search index for the plugin during cron runs, indexing new or modified content.

methods.name: indexClear
methods.description: Clears all items from the search index related to this plugin.

methods.name: markForReindex
methods.description: Marks the search index for reindexing for this plugin.

methods.name: indexStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the index, including remaining items and total items to index.
